Field.name: InputFile1
Field.usage: First input file with distortion fields
Field.manpage: First input file with distortion fields. If this option is not entered, the first non-option argument will be used for this input file.

Field.name: InputFile2
Field.usage: Second input file with distortion fields
Field.manpage: Second input file with distortion fields. If this option is not entered and a second input file is expected, the second non-option argument will be used for this input file.

Field.name: OutputFile
Field.usage: Output file for processed distortion fields (optional)
Field.manpage: Output file for processed distortion fields. If this option is not entered, the second or third non-option argument will be used for the output file, depending on whether one or two input files are required. If no output file is specified at all, then statistics will be computed.

Field.name: Product
Field.usage: Compute product of two distortion fields

Field.name: Difference
Field.usage: Compute difference between two distortion fields

Field.name: Inverse
Field.usage: Compute the inverse of the distortion field

Field.name: Statistics
Field.usage: Report mean, SD, and max of distortion vectors

Field.name: SecondGrid
Field.usage: Use second input file's grid characteristics for output
Field.manpage: If the grid characteristics (spacing and number of grid points) differ between the two files, convert to the second file's characteristics rather than the first.
